settings.description: An SEO-optimized website increases your chances of ranking at the top of Google search results. At PiLiVerse, we build every website with SEO at its core from source code to functionality ensuring fast performance, full responsiveness, and strong search engine visibility.
Page speed is a critical factor in website performance. A fast-loading site keeps visitors engaged, boosts conversions, and builds a strong, professional, and trustworthy brand image.

A high-performing website goes beyond great design it delivers the right features your business needs. From shopping carts and search functions to chatbots, forms, social integrations, and payment systems, every feature is built to be intuitive, seamless, and optimized for all devices.

Without strong security, a website is vulnerable to cyber threats that can compromise data and damage your brand’s reputation. At PiLiVerse, we implement advanced security measures including SSL (HTTPS), data encryption, regular backups, and DDoS protection to keep your website safe, stable, and fully protected 24/7.

A powerful management system is essential for an effective website. It enables businesses to easily operate, update, and maintain their platform without technical barriers or third-party dependence giving you full control, flexibility, and efficiency.

A high-quality website is built for seamless integration with multiple platforms and tools. This streamlines operations, reduces costs, and creates a smoother user experience helping boost conversions and keep customers coming back.

The platform is the backbone of your website. Beyond great design and smooth user experience, a high-performing website must be built on a reliable, scalable, and future-ready platform to support long-term growth.

UX/UI optimization plays a vital role in a website’s success, directly influencing user experience and conversions. At PiLiVerse, we go beyond aesthetics designing websites that are not only beautiful but also intuitive, engaging, and built to convert.

settings.heading: Key Factors for an Effective Website Design
settings.description: While most website design companies deliver standard features like SEO, payment integration, chatbots, and attractive interfaces, not all focus on what truly matters UX/UI optimization. A website built with strong UX/UI doesn’t just look good; it delivers better user experiences, higher customer satisfaction, and stronger conversion rates. Ultimately, this is the key to increasing sales and achieving sustainable business growth.

settings.question: How is the subscription fee calculated?
settings.answer:
The listed prices of all service packages exclude an 8% VAT.
VAT will be applied and added to the total payment amount in accordance with current regulations.

settings.question: If my ad is performing well, should I use all the maximum ad posts for the month?
settings.answer: It is not necessary. The maximum number of ad posts is provided to help you test and compare different content to find the most effective one. If your current ad is delivering good results, there’s no need to make unnecessary changes.

settings.question: How can I make a payment?
settings.answer: You can make a payment to PiLi Verse via bank transfer. We will start working on your campaign as soon as the payment is received.

settings.question: How is the billing cycle calculated?
settings.answer: Payment is applied from the time the advertising campaign goes live.

settings.question: Can I cancel the service before the billing cycle ends?
settings.answer: For the Mini Facebook Ads service, we do not support early cancellation before the billing cycle ends.

settings.question: Can I change my service package?
settings.answer: You can upgrade your service package at any time during the current cycle. However, downgrading to a lower package is only available at the end of the billing cycle.
